title: Matricide
summary: MAT'RICIDE, noun [Latin matricidium; mater, mother, and coedo, to slay.] 1. The killing or murder of a mother. 2. The killer or murderer of his mother.

inlines.v: MAT'RICIDE, noun [Latin matricidium; mater, mother, and coedo, to slay.] 1. The killing or murder of a mother. 2. The killer or murderer of his mother.
